title: Runtime V7 Compact Live Model Probe Pack
description: Cost-conscious live-model scenarios for Runtime V7 product search, service availability, memory, signals, context management, FAQ retrieval, image evidence, and human-agent continuation. Each scenario is isolated and intentionally combines multiple runtime concerns across turns.
run_intent: Use live model clients, live background-signal extraction, live Active Working Memory generation, live FAQ embedding retrieval, and live tool APIs where configured. Do not use scripted model stubs for review runs.

optional_image_env.RUNTIME_V7_TEST_TIRE_IMAGE_URL: Live-accessible tire photo URL for OCR/vision intake scenarios.
optional_image_env.RUNTIME_V7_TEST_CONVERSATION_SCREENSHOT_: Live-accessible screenshot URL of a customer/human-agent conversation snippet.
optional_image_env.RUNTIME_V7_TEST_PRODUCT_CARD_IMAGE_URL: Live-accessible product-card or website-card screenshot URL.

global_review_checklist: Each scenario starts from a fresh harness, fresh in-memory Active Working Memory, fresh product/service observation stores, and a scenario-specific session_id.
Broad or underspecified size-only inquiries may prefer discover_brand_buckets; direct HM plus a complete tire size may present grounded product cards through product_search.
Prices, promos, DOT, origin, warranty, TPP, slots, and branch data appear only from trusted tool outputs or FAQ retrieval.
Service responses do not claim same-day availability unless find_installation_slots or validate_installation_slot supports it.
Installation partner cards are deterministic and concise; model text supplies the conversational lead-in or CTA.

No-walk-in wording applies only to provider-backed partner-site access when installation partner cards or grounded service policy require it. It must not deny installation at the Makati head office, which is itself an installation site.
Background Signals capture normalized tire size, vehicle, location, service type, schedule candidates, quantity, selected refs, and trusted-order-total inputs when present.
Active Working Memory reflects customer language and context without being overruled by stale signals or advisory cues.
Human-agent messages are trusted for context but still require validation before order/payment/schedule actions.
Image evidence is incorporated as supplementary context and background-signal input without becoming action-safe by itself.
FAQ hints remain answer-free; answer_product_faq or answer_service_faq retrieves actual FAQ answers only when useful.
Response text is conversational Taglish when the user uses Taglish, short enough for ManyChat-style bubbles, and avoids robotic pending-check replies.
Artifacts include tool sequence, compiled contexts, capability profile history, latency, usage, cache usage, tool latency, memory after turn, and signal extraction details.

scenarios.title: Size-only HM into budget options, selected details, then close
turns: budget lang boss pero safe pa din
yung una may warranty, dot, origin, installment?
salamat boss may nakuha na muna kami

preferred_tools_by_phase: Turn 1: product_search is allowed for direct HM plus stored/complete 175/65R14 product-card presentation
Turn 2: product_search using stored 175/65R14 and budget preference
Turn 3: resolve_product_reference and get_product_details if visible product refs exist
Turn 4: no product/service tool unless the model needs a grounded policy answer
response_checks: HM with a complete tire size is treated as a product inquiry with grounded product presentation.
Product cards/details are deterministic; model only writes lead-in/CTA or comparison.
Selected detail response shows only customer-facing safe fields.
The final close does not keep pushing products or scheduling.

scenarios.title: Vehicle fitment plus General Trias shorthand and install schedule
turns: boss may rim 15 kayo pang innova? gen tri
need ko sana kabit today kung meron malapit
sige yung sakto lang quality, ano size dapat?

response_checks: Gen tri is normalized to General Trias in signals, tool args, or model response after tool output.
Fitment candidates are not treated as confirmed tire size until customer accepts.
No exact schedule or same-day claim appears without slot grounding.
No made-up branch or installation partner names appear.

scenarios.title: Generic location question, Megamall urgent service, then tire size
turns: Where are you located?
sa may megamall lang. need ko palitan flat tire ko asap
yung sakto lang na quality pa din. 175 65 14 yung nakkaabit ngayon

response_checks: Turn 1 directly explains the reviewed Gulong.ph operating identity and asks a useful area/service follow-up without inventing a retail branch.
Turn 2 resolves Megamall as a landmark-level location and checks service availability if appropriate.
Turn 3 uses the customer-provided size and quality preference instead of repeating earlier questions.
If partner cards are shown, any access reminder is scoped to those partner sites and does not deny head-office installation.

scenarios.title: Lead-form style first message with subtle quantity and install threshold risk
turns: Lead form: tire size 175/65R14, preferred brand Arivo, area Batangas, contact 09XX-XXX-XXXX
2 pcs lang muna boss, pakabit sana today if pwede
kung may 3+1 promo pwede ko rin iconsider

response_checks: First message extracts lead-form fields without leaking or repeating the contact number unnecessarily.
Quantity 2 overrides the default quantity 4 assumption until customer changes it.
If selected SKU price and branch threshold imply installation is not allowed, delivery is surfaced as the grounded alternative.
3+1 promo math is only used if grounded by product output, not from raw text alone.

review_focus: delivery push trigger without obvious prompt wording

scenarios.title: Human-agent commercial context then customer correction

conversation_history.text_content: Customer needs 195/14c. Apollo and Yokohama options were discussed. No walk-ins; installation needs coordination.

turns: Apollo po magkano kung 4 pcs?
ay hindi van boss, Vios pala. 185/60R15. May budget option?
pwede ba ipakabit sa gen tri bukas?

response_checks: Human-agent message is trusted for initial context and memory.
Commercial size 195/14c normalizes to 195R14C without inventing an aspect ratio on the first product turn.
The customer's later correction to Vios and 185/60R15 wins over the older human-agent van context.
Product price and service availability are validated through tools after the correction.
No-walk-in reminder appears if installation partner cards are shown.

review_focus: service validation after corrected product context

scenarios.title: Tire photo, conversation screenshot, and product-card screenshot intake

turns.message: ito po yung usapan namin sa agent, applicable pa ba?
available pa po ba ito ngayon?

response_checks: Image evidence is included in external evidence refs and Background Signals.
OCR/vision evidence remains requires_validation and is not action-safe by itself.
Human-agent screenshot content is trusted as supplementary context but validated before promo/order/schedule claims.
Website product-card screenshot availability is validated through product tools if enough details are extracted.

scenarios.title: 2 AM bukas wording should seed schedule candidates
turns: bukas ng umaga pwede kabit sa makati?
185/60R15 Apollo sana, 4 pcs

response_checks: Request Time in the context is exactly 2026-05-22 02:05:00 Asia/Manila.
The model can treat later 2026-05-22 morning as a high-probability interpretation and 2026-05-23 as an alternative if ambiguous.
Tool calls still pass exact API dates or date ranges.
No slot is presented as booked or confirmed.

scenarios.title: Outside-area typo should normalize and pivot to delivery
turns: bukdinon may branch or installation?
delivery na lang if wala, 185/60R15 Apollo sana

response_checks: Normalizes typo to Bukidnon if confidence is enough.
Does not imply a nearby-branch lookup failed mysteriously when the area is outside install coverage.
Delivery is treated as the primary service alternative.
No partner-site access reminder appears unless partner cards are actually shown.

scenarios.title: SM North should not collapse to broad Quezon City
turns: near SM North need install today
175/65R14 lang yung tire

signals_to_check: location=SM North or SM North EDSA
response_checks: Partner lookup uses landmark-level resolution, not just a generic QC centroid.
No distance is shown in customer presentation.
If partner cards are shown, any access reminder is scoped to those partner sites.

scenarios.title: SLEX should trigger clarification or cautious resolution
turns: SLEX ako boss need tire install
near Alabang exit ako

response_checks: SLEX is recognized as too broad if no exit/city is known.
The second turn should refine the location and proceed instead of asking the same generic question again.
No fabricated precise location is used from the first turn alone.

scenarios.title: Product FAQ then order/payment boundary
turns: brand new ba tires niyo? may warranty?
paano umorder and paano payment?

response_checks: Product FAQ uses retrieved FAQ answer context with source_type=faq.
Order/payment question is not forced into answer_product_faq.
No payment instruction, payment collection, or order finalization is invented.

scenarios.title: Latest customer correction should beat prior in-session memory
turns: 185/60R15 Michelin magkano?
ay mali boss 175/65R14 pala, Apollo or budget lang
pwede install sa Makati tomorrow?

response_checks: The first turn may search Michelin 185/60R15 if the model has enough signal.
The second turn must switch to 175/65R14 and not keep using stale Michelin/185/60R15 context.
Active Working Memory should preserve the correction clearly, not flatten both sizes into equal current facts.
Service lookup should use the corrected product context and Makati schedule context.

scenarios.title: Overconstrained product request should recover when customer relaxes constraints
turns: May Michelin 175/65R14 under 2k?
kahit ibang brand basta safe and mura
pwede ba ipakabit today sa SM North?

response_checks: No unsupported claim that Michelin under 2k is available.
If the exact request has no result, the model explains naturally and offers grounded alternatives only after the customer relaxes constraints.
The relaxed search should not keep Michelin as a hard required brand.
Service lookup should happen only after there is enough location/schedule context.

review_focus: model flexibility after empty or narrow results

scenarios.title: Service addons and inclusions should be grounded by tools
turns: near Makati ako, 185/60R15 need kabit today
may balancing, pito, nitrogen, disposal included?

response_checks: The first turn should establish nearby partners or slots before claiming same-day availability.
Addon/inclusion answers should come from branch addon catalog or service FAQ grounding.
The model should not say all requested services are included unless tool output supports it.
If addon availability differs by partner, the response should preserve that nuance instead of flattening it.

review_focus: service FAQ vs addon tool choice
